scripts.dev:
kill-port 3040 && node -e "console.log('
  GLC Next.js — PORT 3040 (not 3000)
  → http://localhost:3040/
  If the browser says the site cannot be reached, you are on the wrong port.
  Use port 3000 instead: npm run dev:3000
  First compile can take ~10–30s; then refresh. Still broken? npm run dev:fresh
')" && next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3040
scripts.dev:3000:
kill-port 3000 && node -e "console.log('
  GLC Next.js — PORT 3000
  → http://localhost:3000/
')" && next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3000
scripts.dev:fresh: kill-port 3040 && npm run clean && node -e "console.log('\n  GLC Next.js → http://127.0.0.1:3040/ (clean .next)\n')" && next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3040
scripts.dev:turbo: kill-port 3040 && node -e "console.log('\n  Turbopack → http://127.0.0.1:3040/\n')" && next dev --turbopack -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3040
